else.reason: Company Name is not the current legal name unless Current Name Indicator is Y
Current Name is current only where Current Name Indicator is exactly null

then.reason: Type RACN value is an ARBN, not an ACN

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Company name as it appears on the register
field_mappings.transformation: Output raw Company Name as entity.legal_name only where Current Name Indicator equals Y; for every other indicator value (including null) omit this branch so register names are not presented as current.
Output raw Current Name as entity.legal_name only where Current Name Indicator is null (exact null, not blank); otherwise omit this branch. Keep the raw value unchanged.
Parse ACN as a 9-digit checksum-valid ACN only where Type is not RACN; where Type equals RACN the value is an ARBN and is omitted from entity.acn.
Parse ABN as an 11-digit checksum-valid ABN; the documented placeholder value 0 (meaning no ABN) is omitted rather than treated as an identifier.
Map documented codes APTY, APUB and FNOS to company; RACN and any other value resolve to unknown rather than a guessed type.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Date on which a company was registered
field_mappings.transformation: Parse DD/MM/YYYY text into a date using format %d/%m/%Y.

unmapped_fields.reason: Status codes were not narrowed to canonical entity.status values; the same-field definition does not establish a supported canonical meaning for REGD or other codes.
No canonical address.state target: Previous State of Registration records the original state of registration, not the current business address.
Describes the Class of the company (limitation type), not an industry code or entity type; no supported canonical target.
Describes the Sub Class of the company; no supported canonical target.
Date of Deregistration is a lifecycle date with no supported canonical target without whole-observation validity evidence.
Dataset maintenance flag for whether the record was modified since last report; no canonical target.
Current Name Indicator is a condition flag used only to control Current Name and Company Name; it has no separate canonical target.
Name start date for the current name is a historical name lifetime with no supported canonical target.
State Registration number is a state-issued registration number with no canonical target.
Internal native row identifier with no ontology counterpart.
